card.name: Modifier word before a noun
card.fires_on: A modifying word or word-start that sits between a drug or noun and its head noun, such as 'oral' before suspension or 'urinary' before bladder. The next word is a predictable noun completing a compound.

modes.label: Dosage form modifier
modes.description: The word 'oral' after a drug name, before suspension or solution.

modes.label: Anatomy or product modifier
modes.description: An adjective or word-start inside a compound noun phrase in drug text, such as 'urinary' before bladder or 'illed' in prefilled.

modes.label: General web compound nouns
modes.description: A modifying word in a non-medical noun phrase such as wild turkeys or sea containers.
